discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch — fixed in 3efc533e3. `onMessageUpdate` now applies the same `working_dir_missing` guard as `handleSubmit`, returning before `acpChatSessionController.updateMessage` can truncate the stored conversation. Since the edit affordance sits on individual messages (away from the warning banner), the blocked edit shows a toast pointing the user at updating the working directory rather than failing silently.

Fixed in e89fe1974. `ChatInput` gains a dedicated `submissionDisabled` prop (wired into `canSubmit`, `onFormSubmit`, and the send-button state, with its own tooltip), and `BaseChat` passes `submissionDisabled={workingDirMissing}`. Enter/click are blocked before `performSubmit` runs, so the typed text is never cleared while the missing-directory banner is shown. Used a dedicated prop rather than reusing `queueProcessingBlocked` to avoid its "waiting for cancellation" tooltip and queue side effects. New component test covers blocked-and-preserved vs enabled-and-cleared; the tooltip message is translated in all 15 locales.

Fixed. imagePaths from getTextAndImageContent is now included: each image is emitted as a _[image]_ placeholder, and a turn is only skipped when it has neither text nor images. So image-only turns, and images in mixed text/image turns, are preserved rather than dropped. I went with a lightweight placeholder rather than embedding the base64 data: URIs to keep the copied Markdown small and pasteable — the original filename/path isn't retained in the message data, so a placeholder is the most faithful option available
**Fixed in 8b85884.** Good catch — restored the `\!Array.isArray(value)` guard so empty arrays are preserved.
